title: Network delay time
statementMd:
A signal is sent from node `k` through directed edges `[u, v, w]` (travel time `w`) among nodes `1..n`. Return the time for all nodes to receive it, or `-1` if some never do.

**Example:** `network_delay([[2, 1, 1], [2, 3, 1], [3, 4, 1]], 4, 2)` returns `2`.
hints: Dijkstra, then take the maximum distance.
